title: Tool contract v2 — staged pipeline
description: Replaces tools.v1 for the Perceive→Construct→Verify path. Handlers land phase-by-phase.

tools.name: observe
tools.description: Intake + Perceive → observation.v1 and rectified images.

tools.name: set_dims

tools.name: build_ir

tools.name: ask_user
